newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BEBETO FIRES PARTING SHOT AT TROUBLED SEVILLA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BEBETO FIRES PARTING SHOT AT TROUBLED SEVILLA.

text.p: World Cup striker Bebeto has hit out at the management of Sevilla after reaching agreement to leave the troubled Spanish club and join Brazil's Vitoria de Bahia for a $4.125 million fee.

"It's shameful...I feel cheated, the club hasn't fulfilled any of what they promised me." said the Brazilian of his two months at Sevilla, who are fighting to avoid relegation and are immersed in a boardroom struggle.
